note: The reported symptom is an internal failure: dxc dies with 0xC0000005 (reporter quoted ERRORLEVEL -1073741819) and prints no diagnostic at all. `internal_failure` is exit-status based (0xC0000005, 0x80000003, 0xE0000001-3, other 0xC/0xE structured exceptions, POSIX signal exits) with text markers only as a backstop, which is what this issue needs for three reasons. (1) It is crash-shaped, so the same defect surfaces as a trapped assert in the Debug ground-truth build and as a bare access violation in the Release release-binaries; a predicate matching an assert MESSAGE would score every release as clean and manufacture a false 'fixed' verdict. (2) The reported symptom is literally 'no error messages generated', so a text-based crash predicate would be testing for the one thing the report says is absent -- and #3259 measured a release that access-violates with completely empty stderr. (3) It must NOT be a bare nonzero-exit test: dxc returns E_FAIL (0x80004005) for ordinary diagnosed errors, and a diagnosed error is precisely the shape a FIX for this issue would take (see @tex3d 2021-03-15 and @damyanp 2024-07-09: this code should be rejected, not accepted), so conflating the two would report a fix as a reproduction. Controls, all captured: control-no-semantic.hlsl is the repro with only the `: TEXUNIT0` semantic removed and is expected no-match -- it exits 0x80004005 with `error: Semantic must be defined for all parameters of an entry function or patch constant function`, which is exactly the diagnosed-error case this predicate must not confuse with a crash. control-hello.hlsl is a clean ps_6_0 Texture2D/SamplerState/Sample shader, expected no-match, and doubles as a feature-presence probe so an `invalid-probe` on an old release can be attributed. variant-minimal.hlsl is an identity control, expected match.
